description: A second postal lookup at PostalCodes.info. Their licensing page, read on 2026-11-08, permits commercial reuse with attribution. Some countries name ODbL or a national license. One result is returned, not a database dump. Does not spend points and does not accept a URL. If you supply fields, the hub returns privacy_consent_required until the controller has accepted the current privacy version. Do not invent that acceptance.
name: hub_postal-backup
